$comment: PAVEMENT-PINN road-status and routing rules. Read by the routing service (server/services/authorityResolver.ts successor) and the map legend. Every rule carries a source and a status. Status values: VERIFIED (read from an official/primary source on source_date), TODO_VERIFY (not yet confirmed; source to fetch is named), DESIGN (a product design choice, not a legal fact). See 04_AUTHORITY_ROUTING.md.

status_enum.status_set_by: Keputusan Menteri (PP 34/2006 Pasal 62(1)); current: Kepmen PUPR 1688/KPTS/M/2022

status_enum.legal_basis: UU 2/2022 Pasal 9(6) (toll roads are national roads), Pasal 43, 51A
status_enum.status_set_by: Menteri (part of national status); operator by PPJT concession
Owner (BUMN/BUMD/business/community/agency); becomes kab/kota road only after handover + designation

NASIONAL.legal_authority: Pemerintah Pusat - Kementerian PU, Ditjen Bina Marga (UU 2/2022 Pasal 14(1); Perpres 170/2024)
NASIONAL.note: Satker/PPK sub-routing not confirmed from a primary source (note 04 Gap).

TOL.legal_authority: BUJT operator under PPJT; preservation + SPM by BUJT (Permen PU 2/2025 Lampiran C.1 items 14-15)
office_chain: BUJT regional office where known (e.g. jm-metro)
TOL.office_lookup: toll ruas match (name/operator alias) -> bujt_id -> route_to_office_id

PROVINSI.office_lookup: province -> dinas; then UPTD polygon if loaded
PROVINSI.note: Dinas names vary by province; model generically (note 04 §4).

office_chain: Dinas PU/PUPR/Bina Marga kabupaten (directory TODO_VERIFY; seed pipeline in note 05 §5)
KABUPATEN.fallback_when_dinas_unknown: Pemkab main address or SP4N-LAPOR! referral; never an invented dinas address

KOTA.fallback_when_dinas_unknown: Pemkot main address or SP4N-LAPOR! referral

DESA.legal_authority: Pemerintah Desa (UU 2/2022 Pasal 16A(1)); kabupaten regulates and guides (Pasal 16(1))
DESA.office_lookup: desa polygon (kode wilayah 10-digit) -> desa office (directory TODO_VERIFY)

KHUSUS.citizen_notice: This looks like a private or special road. The owner maintains it. We cannot send it to a government office.

snap_max_m.source: _shared_decisions.md (snap <= 25 m); note 05 suggests 15-25 m dense urban, 50 m rural

snap_hard_cap_m.note: Search radius r = max(snap_max_m, min(gps_accuracy_m, snap_hard_cap_m)). If gps_accuracy_m > snap_max_m, confidence is capped at MEDIUM and the citizen is asked to confirm the road.

ambiguity_delta_m.note: Two candidates whose distances differ by less than this are 'ambiguous' (overpass/underpass, toll above arterial, parallel service road).

official_length_tolerance.note: Summed matched OSM length within +/-10% of panjang_km in the SK list (note 05 pipeline step 3; design assumption).

HIGH.definition: Segment status comes from an official list match (Kepmen/Kepgub/Kepbup/Kepwal lampiran, or BPJT ruas list) with match_score >= official_match_min_score, OR an OSM toll tag (highway=motorway|motorway_link or toll=yes); AND the snap is unambiguous AND gps_accuracy_m <= snap_max_m.
HIGH.ui: Shown as 'Sent to <office>'. Coordinator may still transfer (with SK citation).

MEDIUM.definition: Status from a regional open-data default (e.g. DKI non-toll public roads -> PROVINSI per Satu Data Jakarta 2025), OR an official match below threshold, OR OSM highway=trunk outside DKI, OR an ambiguous snap resolved by the citizen's toll/non-toll toggle, OR any HIGH case with gps_accuracy_m > snap_max_m.

LOW.definition: OSM class heuristic only (primary/secondary/tertiary/residential/unclassified), OR DKI trunk without an SK match, OR no segment within the search radius (admin-boundary fallback).
LOW.ui: Shown as 'We think this is <office>. Please confirm.' Coordinator must confirm or transfer before the SLA clock for 'acknowledged' starts.

precedence_of_sources.note: Accepted correction creates a new segment version citing an SK.
BPJT 'Daftar Ruas Jalan Tol dan BUJT Sedang Beroperasi'.
IRMS / Buku Kondisi Jalan Nasional ruas tables if obtained.
e.g. Satu Data Jakarta status table (tabular, no geometry).

osm_heuristics.$comment: From note 05 §2 (OSM wiki Indonesia:Tags/Highway; archived Indonesian Tagging Guidelines). OSM highway class in Indonesia is contested (community thread 145030, July 2026, DWG blocks), so these are weak proxies. Applied only where no official match exists.

rules.note: Then join to BPJT ruas via name/operator alias; unmatched toll -> office = bpjt watcher queue, confidence MEDIUM.
OSM Id:Tag:highway=trunk says trunk roads 'masuk ke dalam kewenangan jalan nasional'. Overridden in DKI (see jakarta_overrides).
Resolve KABUPATEN vs KOTA from the admin polygon type.
Or DESA in rural kabupaten - only if a desa road SK says so; otherwise KABUPATEN.

ref_hint.note: OSM wiki: national roads carry a national-number ref; primary/secondary carry provincial/regency refs. Whether OSM Indonesia uses consistent prefixes (N/P/K) or designation=* was NOT confirmed. Use ref only as a tie-breaker; never to raise confidence. The current authorityResolver.ts treats ref ^\d{1,3}$ as national - keep as tie-breaker only.

jakarta_overrides.$comment: DKI Jakarta has no autonomous kabupaten/kota road authority: 5 kota administrasi + 1 kabupaten administrasi. Satu Data Jakarta 2025 shows STATUS_JALAN=PROVINSI for all road classes in Jakarta Pusat and Jakarta Utara.

default_non_toll_public_road.note: Only Pusat + Utara rows were read; confirm the other kota rows show PROVINSI too (TODO_VERIFY).

trunk_without_sk_match.coordinator_prompt: This may be a national road. Check the Kepmen PUPR 1688/KPTS/M/2022 DKI list before sending.
trunk_without_sk_match.note: National non-toll ruas inside DKI are unknown; a 2016 headline reports 89.33 km transferred to provincial status (article not opened).

national_segments_from_sk.source_to_fetch: Kepmen PUPR 1688/KPTS/M/2022 lampiran (51.58 MB PDF, MD5 4776c9c4158abea64ee1fde3a10538a1) https://binamarga.pu.go.id/index.php/nspk/detail/keputusan-menteri-pupr-nomor-430kptsm2022-tentang-penetapan-ruas-jalan-menurut-statusnya-sebagai-jalan-nasional

provincial_sk.source_to_fetch: JDIH DKI (jdih.jakarta.go.id) - Kepgub on ruas jalan provinsi

kepulauan_seribu.note: Sudin Bina Marga for the kabupaten administrasi not confirmed.

private_estates.note: Roads inside housing developments -> developer/pengelola, shown as non-public (note 05 §4 inference). Requires an estate polygon layer (TODO).

defect_type_overrides.office: dbm-dki -> Bidang Penerangan Jalan dan Sarana Umum / Sudin Seksi PJU
road authority by status (part of ruang manfaat jalan)
defect_type_overrides.note: In DKI, the Dinas SDA (drainage) and PPSU kelurahan roles vs Bina Marga are TODO_VERIFY.

sla_hooks.text: Penyelenggara jalan wajib segera dan patut memperbaiki jalan rusak yang dapat mengakibatkan kecelakaan; if not yet repaired, must put up signs.
sla_hooks.note: No numeric deadline in the law.

Hukumonline op-ed (18 Feb 2026) says SPM requires toll potholes repaired within 2x24 h; detikOto (2021) states no pothole deadline; Permen PU 16/2014 Lampiran I not retrieved; new SPM Permen (2026) enactment not verified. Keep configurable.

map_legend.$comment: Palette from _shared_decisions.md. Checked with a Machado-2009 CVD simulation: minimum pairwise dE76 = 34.5 normal, 16.4 deutan, 24.2 protan, 9.1 tritan. Colour is never the only cue: every line has a text label in the popup and the legend, confidence uses line style.

casing.reason: Cone orange (2.61:1) is below the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text contrast on white; the ink casing carries the contrast.

KOTA.name: Physics cyan
KOTA.note: Same as KABUPATEN; the two never overlap in one area.

reserved_colors.#E5391A: Hazard red - damage reports and SLA breaches only, never an authority
reserved_colors.#E0A100: Signal yellow dark - text-safe yellow for badges

popup_fields: button: Report a status error / Laporkan kesalahan status
